painted_hall.reference: reference_art/01_visual_style.jpg, option B battlefield (style); original Blender deck (registration)
painted_hall.prompt: Produce an original FINISHED IN-GAME ENVIRONMENT BACKGROUND for a premium hand-painted illustrated science-fiction ARPG. The first reference is the style target ONLY: match its particular richly painted materials, saturated indigo/violet shadows against dramatic honey-orange wall lamps, warm sandstone/copper and cold blue iron, rich scarlet hanging banners, crisp selective edgework, chiseled tile corners and beautiful authored detail. Second reference is ONLY a technical map-registration guide; completely REPLACE its uninspired render. Preserve the rectangular footprint and room framing, design the finished illustrated imperial proving hall with a convincing floor that belongs to an ancient military citadel in active use. Aspect ratio 5:3. Camera fixed non-perspective orthographic, mildly elevated three-quarter front view like registration, horizontal back wall with vertical piers, level rectangular floor. Open combat floor: left boundary at 6.25% canvas width, right at 92.5%, straight back wall base at 13.5% height, front boundary at 86.5% height. Keep walkable floor clean of ALL freestanding props, obstacles, people, debris heaps, rails, crates; omit the guide's black rectangles AND their shadows entirely. The actual cover, actors and rail are independent sprites added later. The WALKABLE FLOOR itself needs fabulous hand-painted art: handsome broad blue-plum hexagonal/cut-rectangular pavers and inset iron strips, engraved beveled edge highlights, deliberate wear and a handful of exposed gold-bronze maintenance strips and dark louvres flush in floor; quite varied colored local light with amber pooling from architectural brasiers and blue-violet bounce elsewhere. Flat low-contrast brass ellipse marking in the left center at (27%,50%) and two thin restrained parallel firing-lane lines in the right-center, organically part of the paving. No letters or numbers. Rear and left/right/top/bottom margins give sense of great architectural depth: carved angular relieving arches of imperial blued iron and warm stone, deep tall copper-caged amber furnace lamps, deeply folded red standards with abstract simple trident motifs, brass-trimmed closed rear crew door at x23%, massive worn piers with stepped bases, an inset blue-turquoise sliver of sky or machinery in the rear, and dark armored front trench lip. Create a confident colorful game world with memorable crafted patterns, not a toy, flat grey square tile map or modern military gym. No vanishing-point perspective, don't make walls diagonal or add obstacles, no logo, UI, labels, alphabet, legible lettering, characters, firing dummies, skulls, foreign franchise heraldry, weapons or violence. Cut off architectural details at the top edge naturally; no overhead roof, no border or map margin. One beautiful full-bleed illustrated room.

painted_fixtures.reference: original Blender fixture silhouette (geometry); reference_art/01_visual_style.jpg, option B (style)
painted_fixtures.prompt: Two transparent in-game scenery sprite cutouts for an illustrated sci-fi ARPG. REF 1 is geometry only: horizontal long shallow massing for a waist-high ballistic barricade above, and open rail below. REF 2 is overall painterly material and edge style. Make TWO isolated individual objects, one per row, separated by a large empty transparent horizontal band, perfectly centered, no lettering, no background floor. Both need a horizontal long axis, camera orthographic elevated about 42 degrees, looking from the front at a horizontal row: see top surface and front face, symmetrical about center, no lateral foreshortening or diagonal sloping. TOP row: paint an original low Imperial ballistic rampart, emphatic stepped feet and end piers, compact sloping blue-black enamel iron armor plates with ivory fronts and brass braces, deep plum shadows to low right, warm gold edge light from upper left, a small horizontal inset of burnt crimson enamel, beautiful worked metal and rivets. Its width is ~3 times its total visible height. Weighty anchored defensive short wall or ballistic parapet, not a storage trunk, no lid. BOTTOM row: matching isolated waist-high safety railing at a crew post. Three posts with short flared feet, two horizontal metal rails, open negative space between them, antique brass handrail and dark iron midrail, equal front angle, width 3.7 times its visible height. Dramatic but small-scale readable details, strong silhouettes and handsome metal warm/cool material transitions like the painted walls in reference 2. The major horizontal edges MUST be parallel to top and bottom of image; both objects have the same lighting/camera. NO objects touching or overlapping, no extra variants, no cast ground shadow, no people, cloth, text, white stickers, framing, labels, UI, extraneous rings or pipes, no logo. Original videogame environment art. True alpha background transparent in all holes and all around both objects.

runtime: pack_painted_range.py registers wall bases and footprints, applies fixture contact shadows, exports four deck quarters and three transparent sorted fixtures. No generated prop pixels are baked into the floor.
